PR-20.reason: Add Muse colors, filters, names, handoff, read/ask/edit job controls and owner chat composer. The optional mobile page and default mobile activation behavior are unchanged.

AB-383.reason: AB-383: the dashboard subscribes to GET /api/events while the tab is visible and reads the shown chat or run at once when the history store reports new lines; pushes coalesce into one render and interval polling stays as the safety net; after an error, a visible tab retries the stream (1c75687f, page re-pinned). The optional mobile page and default mobile activation behavior are unchanged.

AB-398.reason: AB-398: the desktop dashboard script shows a paused subagent job: "paused" becomes a known pill status styled like interrupted, a paused group keeps its place with the working ones, shows its pause reason and time in the row and conversation note, offers a resume_subagent hint, and the counts line adds "N paused" (6c3430d1, page re-pinned). The mobileDashboardPage addition, the optional mobile page and default mobile activation behavior are unchanged.
